digest.component_or_area: Backend adapter seam / RemoteRef port member
propositions: RemoteRef.instance is never populated in production code; it must be derived from the configured base URL and injected at backend construction time
The Backend protocol lacks a declared remote_ref() method, while FakeBackend implements it; this asymmetry allows contract tests to pass against a fake strictly more capable than real backends
RemoteRef.instance does not prevent local-ticket-id collision between two deployments of the same vendor, because _jira_key_to_local_id derives the id from the Jira key alone, not from instance
The vendor field already separates Cloud from DataCenter deployments, so instance disambiguates only same-vendor deployments, not the Cloud-vs-DC case its docstring implies
remote_ref() must not resolve configuration at call time; the instance value must be provided at backend construction by the build_backend factories, which already hold resolved settings
